title: Financial Control Manager
description: At International SOS, we are in the business of protecting and saving lives. For 40 years, we have delivered customised security risk management, health, and wellbeing solutions to organisations worldwide. With a presence in 90 countries and a team of nearly 13,000 experts, we provide 24/7 support to help organisations fulfil their Duty of Care responsibilities. Now, we’re looking for talented individuals to join our team and make a difference. ## About the role This role leads the full financial control function for multiple European legal entities, ensuring accurate reporting and strong financial governance. You will partner with both internal and external stakeholders to deliver high‑quality financial processes and continuous improvement. ## Key responsibilities * Lead all financial control activities, including management accounts, statutory reporting, and regulatory submissions: The Netherlands – Blue Cross Travel Services B.V. Spain – International SOS Assistance Iberica SL Other Scandinavian/ Europe LE * Prepare accurate monthly management accounts and annual financial statements. * Oversee annual consolidation packs and transfer pricing documentation. * Manage relationships with auditors, banks, tax consultants, and authorities. * Collaborate with shared service centres to ensure consistent and efficient processes. * Oversee balance sheet components including receivables, payables, and intercompany accounts. * Manage cash flow and treasury activities to ensure liquidity and compliance. * Monitor and manage foreign exchange exposures with accurate reporting. * Identify opportunities to improve financial processes and operational workflows. * Support ad hoc tasks and evolving business requirements. ## About you * A qualified accountant (e.g., RA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) with strong technical knowledge. * Experience working within international or multinational environments. * Management of legal entities in Europe * Skilled in leading financial operations with strong analytical and Excel capabilities. * Able to manage multiple priorities and communicate confidently across all organisational levels. * Collaborative, improvement‑focused, and comfortable working in a dynamic environment. ## Benefits * Competitive salary and incentive scheme * Warm, supportive, and open company culture * An opportunity to thrive in a global environment * Hybrid working #LI-AG1 #Europe #LI-Europe By joining International SOS, you will contribute to a global network dedicated to protecting people and organisations. We offer a dynamic and respectful workplace where expertise, innovation, and collaboration drive our success. International SOS has been awarded as a Top Employer in the UK by the Top Employer’s Institute (TEI) for 2025. 13,000 experts | 1,200+ locations | 90 countries | 110+ languages Start your journey with us today. Apply now!

title: Offshore Emergency Medic
description: ## Overall, Purpose of the Job The Offshore Paramedic is the primary provider of both primary and emergency health care services to the onsite workforce. This role oversees all aspects of clinical and medical management within the offshore clinic, including the preparation and submission of medical evacuation reports. ## Job Profile Required Skills and Knowledge * Comprehensive understanding of international medical and healthcare systems. * Strong background in remote area medicine, with offshore experience preferred. * Mandatory experience working on seismic vessels. * Ability to manage both routine and emergency medical situations in isolated environments. Required Competencies * Adaptability to varied international healthcare practices. * Proficiency in clinical decision-making under resource-limited conditions. * Effective communication and leadership skills in high-pressure scenarios. * Strong organizational and documentation abilities, particularly for medical evacuation procedures. Required Work Experience * Minimum of 3 years’ experience as a Medical Medic. * Post-graduation experience gained within the clinical arena. * Demonstrated capability in handling offshore medical responsibilities. Required Certificates * Advanced Care Level certification or higher. * Basic Life Support (BLS). * Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS). * International Trauma Life Support (ITLS). * Basic Offshore Safety Induction and Emergency Training (BOSIET) / Further Offshore Emergency Training (FOET) * Must be licensed to practice as a paramedic in home country. * Must have a valid work permit in the United Kingdom. This is a short-term assignment with an initial duration of 10 days. However, there is a possibility of extension for up to 6 weeks, depending on project needs. Although International SOS is grateful for your application, only candidates who meet the specified criteria will be contacted. ## Benefits
